description: Compatibility tool for older clients: search the Bullrun ETF universe and optionally bundle profile, recent prices, and latest holdings for an exact ticker. New clients should use search_etfs, get_etf_snapshot, and get_etf_holdings for smaller responses, structured output, quantitative filters, and explicit coverage metadata. Read-only. Successful results include an optional platformLink for continuing this research or reviewing the exact saved draft in Bullrun. When useful, present its descriptive link and respect its description of any settings not carried over.

category.description: Exact broad ETF asset-class filter, such as Equity, Fixed Income, Commodity, Crypto, or Real Estate. Kept as category for API compatibility.

currency.description: Exact trading currency filter, e.g. USD, EUR, CHF.

exchange.description: Exact exchange filter, e.g. NYSE ARCA, LSE, XETRA.

focus.description: Exact ETF exposure filter, such as Japan, Equity - Australia, TOPIX, or an exchange/source exposure label. Kept as focus for API compatibility.

holdingsLimit.description: Maximum holdings to return for an exact ticker, 1-100.

includeHoldings.description: When ticker is supplied, include latest holdings. Ignored for broad searches.

includeInactive.description: Include ETFs with no recent price bar. Default false.

includeSecondary.description: Include secondary/cross-listed ETF tickers. Default false.

limit.description: Maximum ETF search rows to return, 1-100.

priceLimit.description: Recent daily price rows to return for an exact ticker. Use 0 to skip prices.

search.description: Free-text ETF search by ticker or fund name. Omit to list the first ETFs.

ticker.description: Exact ETF ticker for profile, prices, and optional holdings, e.g. SPY, VWRL.L, EUNL.DE.

name: query_etfs
title: Query ETFs
